title: Snake
prompt:
Build Snake on a grid of at least 15x15 cells (20x20 suggested). The snake starts 3 cells long on the centre cell (floor(cols/2), floor(rows/2)) heading right and moves one cell every ticksPerMove ticks (an integer, constant during a game, counted from start()). Eating food scores exactly 10, grows the snake by one and respawns the food on a random free cell. Leaving the grid or moving into the body ends the game. Keyboard: arrows and WASD. Touch: a swipe of at least 30 px on the canvas turns the snake.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, length, head:{x,y}, dir:'up'|'down'|'left'|'right', food:{x,y}, cols, rows, ticksPerMove}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.turn(dir): queue a turn for the next move; turning onto the opposite of the current direction is ignored
- Game.debug.setFood(x, y): move the food to cell (x, y)

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): exact movement timing, turning, growth, wall and self collisions, restart, seeded food, arrow keys and swipes.
